newsitem.title: ITALY: Agip returns to Formula one with Benetton.
newsitem.headline: Agip returns to Formula one with Benetton.

text.p: Italy's Agip SpA said on Friday it was returning to Formula One with the Italian Benetton motor racing team from the start of the season.
"Agip and Benetton Formula One have agreed a technical-sporting collaboration deal for the 1997 world championship," Agip said in a statement.
Agip's fire-breathing six legged dragon emblem was a familiar sight to Grand Prix fans for 20 years with Ferrari.
They pulled out in 1995, the same year Ferrari signed German Michael Schumacher on a hugely expensive contract.
Last year Agip did not sponsor Formula One teams. Benetton, whose drivers are Frenchman Jean Alesi and Austrian Gerhard Berger, were sponsored by French oil company ELF.
